notes: Complete live technical, license, dependency, and ARM64/Cloud compatibility audit of all 33 external GitHub repositories, 5 asset provider portals, and 2 XDX project repositories.

entries.name: fiankuns/XDX-Autonomous-Video-Studio
entries.rationale: Primary v3.3 modular hybrid autonomous video production repository.

entries.name: fiankuns/xdx-blender-studio
entries.rationale: Verified Outbound Relay & USB ADB MCP Bridge for Vivo X200 Pro (17/17 tests pass; zero files modified).

entries.name: JuneYaooo/rea-video
entries.rationale: Adopted as primary Reference Intelligence & Remake Forensics taxonomy; offline FFprobe+OpenCV baseline active by default without unapproved external model downloads.

entries.name: remotion-dev/remotion
entries.rationale: Selected as deterministic frame-based Master Timeline & Compositor (v4.0). Runs in Cloud VM Chromium; entity size license rule recorded in license_registry.json.

entries.name: remotion-dev/skills
entries.rationale: Used as reference best-practice patterns for deterministic Remotion Sequence/spring/caption authoring (not a runtime dependency).

entries.name: mrdoob/three.js
entries.rationale: Selected as deterministic procedural 3D, simulation, glTF 2.0, and technical cutaway engine (v0.187.0).

entries.name: heygen-com/hyperframes
entries.rationale: Evaluated (Bun monorepo HTML-to-MP4 editor); not installed in core to avoid duplicating Remotion master timeline and Bun runtime overhead.

entries.name: greensock/GSAP
entries.rationale: Audited v3.15.1; custom non-OSI license and wall-clock defaults. Kept optional; MIT animejs + Remotion spring/interpolate chosen for core.

entries.name: juliangarnier/anime
entries.rationale: Selected (animejs v4.5.0, MIT) for deterministic seek()-driven motion graphics & kinetic typography.

entries.name: airbnb/lottie-web
entries.rationale: Selected (v5.13.0, MIT) for deterministic frame-stepped vector animations via goToAndStop(frame, true).

entries.name: d3/d3
entries.rationale: Selected modular subset (d3-scale, d3-shape, d3-interpolate, ISC) for deterministic explainer charts without DOM bloat.

entries.name: motion-canvas/motion-canvas
entries.rationale: Audited TypeScript canvas animation editor; omitted from core install to maintain a single Remotion deterministic master timeline.

entries.name: ManimCommunity/manim
entries.rationale: Audited v0.22.1 Python math engine; heavy Cairo/Pango/LaTeX native dependencies—deferred as optional specialist math renderer in Phase 02+.

entries.name: iconify/iconify
entries.rationale: Audited MIT universal icon ecosystem; icon SVG data fetched/cached on-demand with per-set license check rather than bundling 300k icons.

entries.name: pmndrs/react-three-fiber
entries.rationale: Audited MIT React reconciler for Three.js; compatible for Phase 02 @remotion/three inline canvas integration.

entries.name: pmndrs/drei
entries.rationale: Audited MIT R3F helpers; deferred until inline R3F canvas shots require shader helpers, keeping Phase 01 dependency footprint minimal.

entries.name: Alchemist0823/three.quarks
entries.rationale: Audited MIT Three.js particle VFX system; compatible with Three.js v0.187 deterministic stepping when advanced emitters are required.

entries.name: tsparticles/tsparticles
entries.rationale: Audited v4.6.0 2D DOM/Canvas particles; omitted to avoid overlap with deterministic seeded 2D/3D particle presets.

entries.name: pmndrs/postprocessing
entries.rationale: Audited v6.39.6 Zlib post-processing passes for Three.js WebGLRenderer; registered for Phase 02 bloom/DOF/vignette passes.

entries.name: dimforge/rapier
entries.rationale: Audited Rust/WASM deterministic physics engine; registered for Phase 02 rigid-body simulations with fixed timestep.

entries.name: Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-app
entries.rationale: Dual-licensed: code MIT, all 3D models/rigs/animations CC0-1.0. Adopted as CC0 humanoid rig & animation convention.

entries.name: freemocap/freemocap
entries.rationale: AGPL-3.0 markerless mocap with heavy numba/aniposelib/opencv-contrib stack; excluded from core bundle due to AGPL copyleft & multi-camera hardware requirement.

entries.name: cgtinker/BlendArMocap
entries.rationale: GPL-3.0 Blender add-on pinning legacy protobuf==3.20.2 & opencv-contrib; conflicts with modern Python 3.12+ and Android APK sandbox.

entries.name: Rokoko/rokoko-studio-live-blender
entries.rationale: LGPL-3.0 Blender bone-naming & retargeting reference; desktop Rokoko Studio Live socket not used on Vivo X200 Pro.

entries.name: google-ai-edge/mediapipe
entries.rationale: Apache-2.0 pose/face landmark ML framework; compatible with Android ARM64 & Linux x86_64 as optional offline motion extractor.

entries.name: DanielSWolf/rhubarb-lip-sync
entries.rationale: MIT C++ CLI generating Preston Blair A-H + X mouth cues from WAV; integrated via adapters/rhubarb_lipsync_adapter.py with off-screen VO fallback.

entries.name: asu37/Rigger
entries.rationale: GPL-3.0 experimental Blender add-on (7 stars); not installed on Vivo X200 Pro to protect XDX Blender Studio stability.

entries.name: ggml-org/whisper.cpp
entries.rationale: MIT C/C++ Whisper v1.9.6 with ARM NEON support; primary recommended offline ASR binary for Android ARM64 & CPU cloud.

entries.name: SYSTRAN/faster-whisper
entries.rationale: MIT CTranslate2 Whisper; declared as optional extra [asr] in pyproject.toml via adapters/whisper_caption_adapter.py.

entries.name: m-bain/whisperX
entries.rationale: BSD-2-Clause word-level forced alignment; heavy PyTorch/pyannote dependency chain kept optional for cloud GPU runs.

entries.name: jianfch/stable-ts
entries.rationale: Repository is ARCHIVED (May 2026); superseded by faster-whisper and whisper.cpp.

entries.name: remotion-dev/animated-captions
entries.rationale: package.json declares 'license': 'UNLICENSED' and 'private': true; blocked by LicenseValidator—replaced by original XDX MIT caption presets + @remotion/captions.

entries.name: neutral-Stage/remotion-captioneer
entries.rationale: MIT v1.2.0 Remotion caption component; relies on external cloud ASR APIs by default, so local @remotion/captions + Whisper adapter is preferred.

entries.name: Poly-Haven/Public-API
entries.rationale: Queried strictly over HTTPS REST (https://api.polyhaven.com) via adapters/polyhaven_adapter.py to discover/download CC0 HDRIs, PBR textures, and models on-demand.

entries.name: Poly-Haven/polyhavenassets
entries.rationale: GPL-3.0 desktop Blender Asset Browser add-on; omitted in favor of XDX targeted HTTP CC0 cache manager safe for Android scoped storage.

entries.name: Poly Haven (polyhaven.com)
entries.rationale: Verified HTTP 200 & JSON API (api.polyhaven.com); CC0 HDRIs, PBR textures, and 3D models downloaded on-demand only.

entries.name: ambientCG (ambientcg.com)
entries.rationale: Verified HTTP 200 & v2 JSON API (2,943+ CC0 PBR materials); queried on-demand via adapters/ambientcg_adapter.py.

entries.name: Kenney Assets (kenney.nl/assets)
entries.rationale: Verified HTTP 200; CC0 stylized low-poly/modular props & UI SFX compatible with mobile_guard budgets (note: noai meta tag respected—used only as standard 3D/audio assets, never for ML training).

entries.name: Quaternius (quaternius.com)
entries.rationale: Verified HTTP 200; CC0 rigged low-poly stylized characters & modular environment packs ideal for Vivo X200 Pro & Three.js.

entries.name: Google Fonts (fonts.google.com)
entries.rationale: Verified HTTP 200; primary source for OFL-1.1 Indonesian & multi-genre typography (Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, Space Grotesk, Merriweather, JetBrains Mono).
